kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أتهايأ (form VI)
# أَتَهَايَأُ (ʔatahāyaʔu) /ʔa.ta.haː.ja.ʔu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَهَايَأَ (tahāyaʔa)
# أَتَهَايَأَ (ʔatahāyaʔa) /ʔa.ta.haː.ja.ʔa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَهَايَأَ (tahāyaʔa)
# أَتَهَايَأْ (ʔatahāyaʔ) /ʔa.ta.haː.jaʔ/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَهَايَأَ (tahāyaʔa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
